messages:
Ava: Quick sync — we need to finalize the criteria for the next beta cohort (signals, sample size, and acceptance heuristics).
Diego: Top priority is workload diversity. ask for 3 sample prompts + 1 traffic pattern example. keep it short.
Priya: Agree. Need to capture peak QPS and average request size for routing decisions.
Sam: Also want a customer success contact and a primary use-case tag for feedback routing :+1:
Ava: Proposed acceptance signals: 1) daily active calls >= 50 for 2 weeks, 2) at least one production integration, 3) legal ok on data sharing. thoughts?
Diego: Can we relax the DAU to 20 if they have high latency sensitivity? Some partners are low volume/high impact.
Priya: Yes — add a 'latency-critical' flag that overrides DAU threshold. We'll need a short checklist for infra entitlements.
Sam: Compensation: $5k in cloud credits or waived charges for first 3 months. Also NDA + secure S3 share. ok?
Ava: That matches earlier budget. I'll add a checkbox for 'has KMS/HSM requirement' to route to private engagements.
oncall-bot: reminder: next infra sync Fri 10am to review capacity for new cohorts
Diego: For metrics, propose we capture: end-to-end p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, hallucination rate on eval set, and subjective satisfaction (1-5) each week.
Priya: For hallucination rate we need a small reference prompt set. I'll paste a screener snippet:
```json
{"screener_prompts":["summarize invoice","answer product policy question","rewrite for tone"]}
```
Sam: How big should cohort be? I vote 8-12 active customers per wave to keep ops manageable.
Ava: Agreed. Also set a 2-week ramp (enable -> observe -> enable more traffic) and a 6-week evaluation window.
Diego: Acceptance KPI: 80% weekly uptime, p95 < 1.2s for <2k tokens, and qualitative 'would recommend' >= 4 from dev contacts.
Priya: We should include a rollback policy: automatic traffic cut to hosted fallback if errors > 5% or p95 degrades by 2x.
Sam: Who owns onboarding docs? I'll take the deployment runbook and sample prompts. Ava will own partner comms.
Ava: I'll draft the invite email and screener survey. Target send date: next Tue. Need final criteria by EOD Monday.
Diego: I'll pull a taxonomy of use-cases and sample prompts to seed invites.
Priya: I'll add the infra entitlement form and prepare a short infra SLA note.
Sam: I'll collect success stories and 2 early customer contacts for references.
Ava: Thanks — next steps: Priya + Diego update the matrix, Sam + I finalize offer comps, we'll review Mon 4pm. :raised_hands:
oncall-bot: calendar event created: Beta Cohort Criteria Review — Mon 16:00
